verdicts.reason: A: everything is pushed to a margin of about 10px, so the wordmark, headline and pills are jammed against the left edge. The subtitle sits almost on top of the pill row, and the decorative circles have been pulled fully into view, so they look more like stacked blobs than bleeding accents. B: keeps the original's 44px left margin and its hierarchy. However, it also turns the edge-bleeding circles into whole discs that crowd the text block and the CTA. The pill labels are tiny and look squeezed ('BLOODORANGE' runs together), so they would not be readable at banner size.
